name: Putting God First
overview: Scripture calls believers to prioritize God above all else by faithfully keeping His commandments and acknowledging Him in every aspect of life, as Proverbs instructs. By committing our works to the Lord, we receive guidance and stability for our thoughts. Jesus further teaches that earthly treasures are fleeting and that one cannot serve both God and material wealth, emphasizing the necessity of wholehearted devotion. Trusting God to provide daily needs frees believers from anxious thoughts, reinforcing the call to put God first in all things.
